text.title: PR Mentoring Session Protocol — Output Contract
text.summary: JSON Schema (draft-07) for the PR-mentoring session record: one PR, junior and senior, named `inputs[]` entries for `learning_goal` (one observable behaviour), `observed_gap` (did / should), `restated_gap`, `comment_counts` per Conventional Comments label with at least one praise, `deferred_findings`, `session_outcome`; the junior-authored fix commit; progression linked to the prior record with `prior_action_status` and a not-demonstrated streak; a decision naming the follow-up PR within 14 days or two PRs, with escalation on the third miss; the junior's confirmation; evidence anchored to diff lines. Validator in scripts/validate-pr-mentoring-session-protocol.py enforces it, including the nit-storm and fix-author rules.

required.field: named entries: `learning_goal` (one observable behaviour, no attitude words), `observed_gap` (`did`, `should`), `restated_gap` (the junior's words), `comment_counts` (issue, suggestion, question, nitpick, praise, thought; praise at least 1), `deferred_findings[]` (url + note), `session_outcome` (r-one-observable-learning-goal, r-observed-gap-cites-diff-line, r-junior-restates-and-writes-the-fix, r-comments-labelled-with-counts)
`url` and `author`, or `null` while the junior is still writing it; the author must be the junior (r-junior-restates-and-writes-the-fix)
`prior_record_url` or null, `prior_action_status` (demonstrated | partial | not-demonstrated) when a prior record exists, `not_demonstrated_streak` (r-progression-linked-to-prior-session)

`follow_up_action` (an observable behaviour, not "keep this in mind"), `demonstrate_in` (`window_days` at most 14 or `next_two_prs`, `url` once the PR exists), `escalation` (intervention + engineering manager) when the streak reaches 3 (r-follow-up-is-a-named-next-pr, r-progression-linked-to-prior-session)
at least two URLs; one is a line-level diff or review-comment anchor (`#discussion_r`, `#L`, `#note_`, `#diff`); the prior record and the follow-up PR when they exist (r-observed-gap-cites-diff-line)
`open` until the follow-up PR URL is recorded, then `closed` (r-follow-up-is-a-named-next-pr)

forbidden.pattern: `observed_gap.did` / `should` phrased about the person ("sloppy", "rushed", "careless"), or no line-level URL in `evidence[]` — fm-gap-is-a-trait
`prior_record_url` set with no `prior_action_status`, or a new `learning_goal` while the prior one is `not-demonstrated` — fm-goal-of-the-week
`comment_counts.nitpick` greater than the sum of all other labels with `session_outcome: learning_goal_addressed` — fm-nit-storm
`follow_up_action` containing "keep this in mind", "be careful" or "next time"; `window_days` above 14; `status: closed` with no `demonstrate_in.url` — fm-follow-up-never-checked
`learning_goal` phrased as an attitude ("be more careful", "think about edge cases") or naming two skills — r-one-observable-learning-goal
`not_demonstrated_streak` of 3 or more with no `decision.escalation` — r-progression-linked-to-prior-session

list.item: `learning_goal` names one skill as a code behaviour the next PR can show (r-one-observable-learning-goal).
`observed_gap` says what the code did and should do, and `evidence[]` has the diff-line or comment anchor (r-observed-gap-cites-diff-line).
`comment_counts` has every label, praise at least 1, and a nitpick majority forces `session_outcome: learning_goal_not_addressed` (r-comments-labelled-with-counts).
`restated_gap` is in the junior's words and `fix_commit.author` is the junior (r-junior-restates-and-writes-the-fix).
`session.pr_url` is one PR and unrelated problems sit in `deferred_findings` (r-session-scoped-to-one-pr-and-goal).
`decision.follow_up_action` is a behaviour with a window of at most 14 days or the next two PRs; `status` is `closed` only once `demonstrate_in.url` exists (r-follow-up-is-a-named-next-pr).
`progression.prior_record_url` is linked with `prior_action_status`; a streak of 3 carries `decision.escalation` (r-progression-linked-to-prior-session).
